title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: A comprehensive, industry-aligned roadmap for Computer Vision Engineers, covering foundational concepts, deep learning for vision, MLOps, deployment, responsible AI, and practical project development.

tree.name: Foundational Concepts: Math, Python, and Traditional CV
tree.description: Master the mathematical underpinnings, core Python libraries, and traditional image processing techniques crucial for understanding modern computer vision. This module lays the groundwork for advanced deep learning applications.

resources.title: OpenCV Course - Full Tutorial with Python (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Python Scientific Stack: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
children.description: Learn to efficiently manipulate numerical data with NumPy, handle structured data with Pandas, and visualize results with Matplotlib, forming the backbone of data science and machine learning workflows in computer vision.

children.name: Version Control with Git
children.description: Learn the fundamental principles of Git for version control, including basic commands (commit, push, pull, branch, merge), repository management, and collaborative development workflows, essential for any software engineering or ML project.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Mathematical Foundations for CV
children.description: Review essential linear algebra (vector spaces, matrices, transformations), calculus (gradients, optimization), and probability & statistics (distributions, Bayes' theorem) concepts as they directly apply to image processing, computer vision algorithms, and neural networks.

children.name: Digital Image Fundamentals and Pre-processing
children.description: Understand how digital images are represented (pixels, channels, color spaces like RGB, HSV, Grayscale), common image formats (JPEG, PNG), and fundamental pre-processing techniques such as resizing, cropping, rotation, histogram equalization, and basic noise reduction.

children.name: Traditional Image Analysis with OpenCV
children.description: Dive into classic computer vision algorithms including image filtering (convolution, blurring, sharpening), edge detection (Sobel, Canny, Laplacian), feature extraction (Harris, SIFT, SURF, ORB), morphological operations (erosion, dilation), segmentation (thresholding, connected components, watershed), and geometric transformations (translation, rotation, scaling, affine).

resources.title: OpenCV Course - Full Tutorial for Beginners (Python)

children.name: Camera Models and Calibration
children.description: Understand the pinhole camera model, intrinsic (focal length, principal point) and extrinsic (rotation, translation) parameters, lens distortion models (radial, tangential), and techniques for camera calibration to remove distortions and estimate real-world coordinates from image points.

resources.title: Camera Calibration Tutorial with OpenCV - Python
Understanding the Pinhole Camera Model (Computer Vision)

tree.name: Deep Learning Core Concepts and Frameworks
tree.description: Build a strong understanding of neural networks, convolutional architectures, and practical skills in major deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow, crucial for modern computer vision.

resources.title: PyTorch Course - Learn PyTorch for Deep Learning

children.name: Machine Learning & Deep Learning Refresher
children.description: Quick review of foundational machine learning concepts including supervised vs. unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, model training, validation, testing, overfitting/underfitting, and a gentle introduction to artificial neural networks.

resources.title: Machine Learning for Everybody - Full Course

children.name: GPU Acceleration and CUDA Basics
children.description: Understand the role of GPUs in accelerating deep learning training and inference. Learn about NVIDIA CUDA toolkit, cuDNN, and how to configure deep learning frameworks to effectively utilize GPU resources for high-performance computing.

resources.title: Getting started with PyTorch on CUDA
How to Setup an NVIDIA GPU for Deep Learning in 2024 (CUDA, cuDNN, PyTorch, TensorFlow, WSL2)

children.name: Neural Networks and CNN Architectures
children.description: Explore the building blocks of neural networks: perceptrons, activation functions, loss functions, forward and backward propagation. Delve into key CNN architectures: LeNet, AlexNet, VGG, ResNet, Inception, understanding their unique contributions and how they learn hierarchical features.

resources.title: CS231n: Convolutional Neural Networks for Visual Recognition
Neural Networks Explained - Machine Learning Tutorial for Beginners
CNN Architectures Explained | LeNet, AlexNet, VGG, Inception, ResNet

children.name: Training Deep Learning Models: Optimization and Regularization
children.description: Master the techniques for effectively training deep neural networks, including understanding various loss functions, optimizers (SGD, Adam, RMSprop), learning rate scheduling, regularization (dropout, batch normalization, L1/L2), and hyperparameter tuning strategies.

resources.title: An Overview of Gradient Descent Optimization Algorithms
Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
Activation Functions, Loss Functions & Optimizers in Neural Networks | Keras & Tensorflow Tutorial

children.name: Deep Learning Frameworks: PyTorch/TensorFlow
children.description: Gain hands-on experience with either PyTorch or TensorFlow, covering data loading with custom datasets and dataloaders, model definition, building training loops, managing device allocation (CPU/GPU), and basic model saving/loading.

resources.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning - Full Course
TensorFlow 2.0 Tutorial for Beginners - Learn how to use TensorFlow 2.0 and Keras

tree.name: Deep Learning for Core Computer Vision Tasks
tree.description: Learn to apply deep learning models to solve fundamental computer vision problems such as image classification, object detection, and semantic/instance segmentation, mastering the practical application of these techniques.

resources.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision with Python and TensorFlow (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Data Annotation and Dataset Management
children.description: Master techniques for annotating images/videos for various vision tasks (bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints), managing dataset versions, ensuring data quality, handling class imbalances, and ethical considerations in data collection.

resources.title: How to Build Your Own Custom Object Detection Model (with YOLOv7)
How to Use Data Augmentation for Image Recognition in PyTorch

children.name: Project: Data Quality Audit and Preprocessing
children.description: Conduct a thorough inspection of a real-world dataset to identify label errors, inconsistencies, class imbalance, and apply appropriate preprocessing, augmentation (e.g., albumentations, imgaug), and data splitting strategies to prepare for model training.

resources.title: Image Data Augmentation for Deep Learning with Keras and Tensorflow
Full Stack Deep Learning Course - Lecture 4: Data

children.name: Image Classification
children.description: Implement and evaluate image classification models, covering advanced concepts like transfer learning, fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, data augmentation, and understanding performance metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrices, ROC curves).

resources.title: Image Classification with Keras: Transfer Learning, Data Augmentation, and more

children.name: Object Detection Models
children.description: Explore state-of-the-art object detection algorithms, including two-stage detectors (R-CNN family: Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN) and one-stage detectors (YOLO series: YOLOv3, YOLOv5, YOLOv8; SSD), along with their evaluation metrics (IoU, mAP, AP50, AP75).

resources.title: YOLO (You Only Look Once) Official Website
Object Detection in 7 Minutes | YOLO, SSD, R-CNN, Faster R-CNN
YOLOv8 Tutorial - Object Detection with Custom Data

children.name: Semantic and Instance Segmentation
children.description: Learn about pixel-wise classification (semantic segmentation) using fully convolutional networks (FCNs), U-Net, DeepLab, and object-aware segmentation (instance segmentation) with models like Mask R-CNN and panoptic segmentation approaches. Understand common datasets like Cityscapes and COCO.

resources.title: U-Net from Scratch in PyTorch | Semantic Segmentation Tutorial
Image Segmentation Tutorial: U-Net and Mask R-CNN Explained

children.name: Keypoint Detection and Pose Estimation
children.description: Explore techniques for detecting specific keypoints (e.g., facial landmarks, human body joints) in images and videos. Learn about popular models for 2D and 3D pose estimation, such as OpenPose, AlphaPose, and HRNet, and their applications in human-computer interaction, robotics, and sports analytics.

resources.title: Pose Estimation Explained: From Theory to Applications
Human Pose Estimation Tutorial with OpenPose and OpenCV

children.name: Project: End-to-End Object Detection/Segmentation Application
children.description: Apply knowledge of object detection or segmentation to a real-world problem. This project involves dataset preparation, model selection/training (using pre-trained models and fine-tuning), evaluation, and basic deployment demonstration, consolidating practical skills.

resources.title: YOLOv8 Tutorial for Beginners - Custom Object Detection Using YOLOv8
Build a Computer Vision App for Product Defect Detection - Mask R-CNN Tutorial

tree.name: Advanced Computer Vision Techniques
tree.description: Delve into more specialized and cutting-edge computer vision topics, including video analysis, generative models, self-supervised learning, and 3D vision, pushing the boundaries of what CV can achieve.

resources.title: GANs - Generative Adversarial Networks | Deep Learning Tutorial

children.name: Video Processing and Object Tracking
children.description: Understand how to process video streams efficiently, implement robust object tracking algorithms (e.g., SORT, DeepSORT, Kalman Filters, state-of-the-art multi-object tracking), analyze motion, estimate optical flow, and manage real-time performance considerations for video analytics.

resources.title: OpenCV Video Analysis and Object Tracking
YOLOv8 Object Tracking with DeepSORT in Python - Computer Vision Tutorial

children.name: Generative Models for Vision (GANs, VAEs, Diffusion Models)
children.description: Explore Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and Diffusion Models for tasks like realistic image generation, style transfer, super-resolution, data augmentation, and image-to-image translation. Understand their architectures and training challenges.

children.name: Self-Supervised Learning and Vision Transformers
children.description: Learn about methods for pre-training powerful models without explicit human labels (e.g., SimCLR, BYOL, MAE) and the rising importance of Transformer architectures in computer vision (Vision Transformers ViT, DETR, Swin Transformers), understanding their attention mechanisms and scalability.

resources.title: Vision Transformers EXPLAINED! (ViT, DETR, Swin Transformers)
What is Self-Supervised Learning? (Intuition, Contrastive Learning, BYOL, MAE)

children.name: 3D Computer Vision and Scene Understanding
children.description: Explore techniques for perceiving and reconstructing 3D information from 2D images. Topics include stereo vision, structure-from-motion (SfM), Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), point clouds, 3D object detection, and neural radiance fields (NeRFs) for novel view synthesis.

resources.title: Stanford CS231A: Computer Vision. From 2D to 3D. (Lecture series)

tree.name: MLOps, Deployment, and Production for CV Models
tree.description: Understand the full lifecycle of computer vision models in production, from data and model versioning to scalable deployment, monitoring, and optimization for various real-world environments.

resources.title: MLOps Tutorial for Beginners - Deploy a Machine Learning Model with TensorFlow Serving, Docker, and Kubernetes

children.name: Experiment Tracking and Model Versioning
children.description: Implement tools and practices for tracking experiments (parameters, metrics, artifacts), managing dataset and model versions, ensuring reproducibility, and facilitating collaborative development in an MLOps environment using tools like MLflow, Weights & Biases, and DVC.

resources.title: DVC with Git - Version Control for Data Science Projects

children.name: Model Deployment Strategies: Cloud, API, Streaming
children.description: Learn to deploy CV models as robust REST APIs using frameworks like Flask/FastAPI, containerize applications with Docker, orchestrate scalable deployments with Kubernetes, and leverage cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) for managed and auto-scaling inference endpoints.

resources.title: Deploy a Machine Learning Model with FastAPI & Docker - Full Course
Deploy a PyTorch Model to Production with AWS SageMaker

children.name: Edge Device Optimization and Inference
children.description: Optimize CV models for constrained environments: techniques like quantization (post-training, quantization-aware), pruning, model distillation, and deployment on edge devices like NVIDIA Jetson, Google Coral, or mobile platforms using specialized tools like ONNX, TensorRT, and TensorFlow Lite.

resources.title: TensorFlow Lite Tutorial: Machine Learning on Mobile & Embedded Devices
NVIDIA TensorRT Explained | Build an AI Inference Engine in Python

children.name: Model Monitoring, Drift, and Explainability
children.description: Set up comprehensive systems for monitoring model performance in production, detecting data drift and concept drift, and understanding model predictions through explainable AI (XAI) techniques like LIME, SHAP, Grad-CAM, and counterfactual explanations to build trust and debug issues.

resources.title: MLOps: What is Model Monitoring and How to Implement It
Explainable AI (XAI) in Machine Learning | LIME, SHAP, and Interpretable Models

tree.name: Responsible AI and Capstone Projects
tree.description: Address critical ethical considerations in computer vision, understand and implement responsible AI practices, and apply all acquired knowledge to build comprehensive, real-world capstone projects that demonstrate industry readiness.

resources.title: What is Responsible AI? | Google Cloud AI Ethics & Governance
Complete Machine Learning Project in Python (Step-by-Step)

children.name: Ethics, Bias, and Privacy in Computer Vision
children.description: Examine potential biases in CV models and datasets (e.g., gender, race), discuss fairness metrics, understand privacy concerns (e.g., facial recognition, data anonymization), and explore ethical guidelines and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, AI Act) for responsible AI development.

resources.title: What is the EU AI Act? (Simplified Explanation)

children.name: Adversarial Attacks and Model Robustness
children.description: Investigate methods for adversarial attacks (e.g., FGSM, PGD) that can fool CV models and explore defense mechanisms to improve model robustness and security. Understand the implications for critical applications like autonomous driving and surveillance.

resources.title: Adversarial Examples in the Physical World
Adversarial Attacks Explained! FGSM, PGD, CW attacks
Adversarial Attacks - How to Fool a Neural Network

children.name: Industry-Standard Capstone Project
children.description: Execute an end-to-end computer vision project, from problem definition, literature review, and data collection to model development, MLOps integration, deployment as a user-friendly application (e.g., with Gradio/Streamlit), and thorough performance evaluation, culminating in a robust demo and detailed report.

resources.title: Build and Deploy a Machine Learning App with Gradio - Full Course
MLOps Course - Machine Learning DevOps for Beginners
